audience.text: Developers building .NET applications targeting .NET Framework 4.8, .NET Standard 2.0, or .NET 8+ who need local, offline OCR without external services.

capabilities.text: Embeds detection, refinement, and recognition ONNX models directly in the assembly, running entirely on the local CPU via ONNX Runtime.
capabilities.title: Local OCR with embedded models

capabilities.text: Processes single raster images (`InputType.SingleImage`) and multi-page PDFs (`InputType.PDF`) with one API call.
capabilities.title: Multi-format input support

capabilities.text: Returns `RecognitionResult` objects containing full text and `RecognitionLinesResult` with `System.Drawing.Rectangle` coordinates for each detected line.
capabilities.title: Line-level output with coordinates

capabilities.text: Recognizes Latin-script text including diacritical characters supported by the embedded recognition model.
capabilities.title: Latin-script recognition

capabilities.text: Targets netstandard2.0, net48, net8.0, net9.0, and net10.0, enabling use across multiple .NET runtime versions.
capabilities.title: Cross-framework compatibility

limitations.text: Image processing is Windows-only due to dependency on `System.Drawing.Common`.
PDF rendering is fixed at 150 DPI with no configurable resolution.
No GPU execution support; inference uses CPU execution provider only.
No support for automatic rotation, deskewing, color inversion, or user-configurable preprocessing.
No confidence scores, font detection, table structure, or barcode detection.
No language selection API; recognition is limited to the embedded Latin alphabet.

problems_solved.text: Enables offline text recognition from images and PDFs without network calls or external model downloads.
Provides structured output with both recognized text and spatial coordinates of detected lines.
Supports batch processing of multiple images or PDF pages in a single API call while preserving order.

product_summary.text: Aspose.OCR.FOSS is a free, open-source OCR library for .NET that performs local text detection and recognition on raster images and PDF documents using embedded ONNX models.

uncertainties: Whether the embedded ONNX models include support for non-Latin scripts beyond diacritical Latin characters.
How the library handles corrupted or malformed PDF files during rendering.
Whether the 150-DPI PDF rendering resolution can be adjusted in future versions.
Whether polygonal text regions or layout labels may be exposed in future API versions.
Whether the large package size due to embedded models will be addressed in future releases.
Whether input-level multithreading will be added to complement ONNX Runtime's intra-operation parallelism.
Whether the public API will evolve beyond its current compact shape as capabilities extend.
Whether non-Windows platforms will be supported if System.Drawing.Common dependencies change.

workflows.name: Build from source
workflows.text: Build the solution using `dotnet build Aspose.Ocr.Foss.sln`.

workflows.name: Install via NuGet
workflows.text: Install the package using `dotnet add package Aspose.OCR.FOSS`.
